_comment: V3 — 6-state architecture, 2-tool pattern (extract details + trigger boolean), filler phrases for latency management. No backward transitions.

general_tools.name: end_call
general_tools.description: End the call politely when the user has no more queries

tools.name: extract_greeter_details
tools.description: Extract caller name and intent. Call ONCE when intent is confirmed and name is captured. Pass actual values — never empty arguments.

variables.name: customer_name
variables.description: The customer's full name. Required for transition.

variables.name: classified_intent
variables.description: Why the customer is calling

tools.name: trigger_greeter_transition
tools.description: Trigger the transition to triage. Call ONLY after extract_greeter_details has been called with non-null values.

variables.name: greeting_exchanged
variables.description: Set to true to transition to triage

tools.name: extract_triage_details
tools.description: Extract symptom details, problem category, boiler brand, and error code. Call ONCE when all are captured. Pass actual values — never empty arguments.

variables.name: problem_category
variables.description: Category of the heating issue

variables.name: symptom_brief
variables.description: 1-2 sentence summary of symptoms for the engineer

variables.name: boiler_make
variables.description: Boiler brand (Worcester, Vaillant, Ideal, Baxi, etc.) or 'unknown' if customer doesn't know

variables.name: error_code
variables.description: Error code shown on boiler display, or 'none' if no error code

tools.name: trigger_triage_transition
tools.description: Trigger the transition to address. Call ONLY after extract_triage_details has been called with non-null values.

variables.name: triage_complete
variables.description: Set to true to transition to address

tools.name: extract_address_details
tools.description: Extract address fields. Call ONCE when customer has confirmed the full address. Pass actual values — never empty arguments.

variables.name: address_house_number
variables.description: House number or property name. Required for transition.

variables.name: address_street
variables.description: Street name

variables.name: address_city
variables.description: City or town

variables.name: address_postcode
variables.description: UK postcode or 'N/A' if customer doesn't know. Required for transition.

tools.name: trigger_address_transition
tools.description: Trigger the transition to slot_selection. Call ONLY after extract_address_details has been called and customer confirmed the address.

variables.name: address_confirmed
variables.description: Set to true ONLY after customer has confirmed the full address readback

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check available appointment slots for a date range

tools.name: extract_slot_details
tools.description: Extract the selected slot details. Pass actual values — never empty arguments.

variables.name: selected_slot_start
variables.description: ISO 8601 UTC with Z suffix — the exact start time from check_availability result. Required for transition.

variables.name: selected_slot_label
variables.description: The spoken form used when offering the slot, e.g. 'Thursday at 2 PM'

tools.name: trigger_slot_transition
tools.description: Trigger the transition to confirmation. Call ONLY after extract_slot_details has been called with non-null values.

variables.name: slot_selected
variables.description: Set to true to transition to confirmation

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Safeguard: refetch slots if customer wants a different slot.

tools.name: extract_confirm_details
tools.description: Extract and lock in confirmation details. Pass actual values — never empty arguments.

variables.name: selected_slot_start
variables.description: ISO 8601 UTC with Z suffix — the new slot start time

variables.name: selected_slot_label
variables.description: The new spoken form, e.g. 'Friday at 10 AM'

variables.name: booking_slot_string
variables.description: Copy the exact value of selected_slot_start (ISO 8601 UTC). Required for transition.

tools.name: trigger_confirm_transition
tools.description: Trigger the transition to booking. Call ONLY after extract_confirm_details has been called and customer has confirmed.

variables.name: booking_confirmed
variables.description: Set to true ONLY after customer has confirmed the slot

tools.name: book_calendar
tools.description: Book a confirmed appointment via Cal.com API. Only call after pre-flight check passes.

tools.name: extract_booking_details
tools.description: Extract missing booking details if pre-flight check fails. Pass actual values — never empty arguments.

variables.name: customer_name
variables.description: The customer's full name

variables.name: address_house_number
variables.description: House number or property name

variables.name: booking_slot_string
variables.description: ISO 8601 UTC with Z suffix, copied from selected_slot_start
